info.title: Hera API
info.description: KYT, AML screening and Travel Rule for Stellar and EVM chains. Every error is `{ error: { code, message, fields? } }`. Every response carries an `x-request-id` header. All timestamps are ISO 8601 UTC.

sessionCookie.name: hera_session
sessionCookie.description: Dashboard session from POST /v1/auth/login or /signup. Mutations must send `Content-Type: application/json` (CSRF defence). Roles: viewer < analyst < admin < owner; each operation lists its minimum in `x-hera-min-role`.

apiKey.description: API key as `Authorization: Bearer hera_live_…`. Keys carry scopes (read, screen, monitor, travel_rule); the scope an operation needs is listed in its security requirement and in `x-hera-api-key-scope`. Keys get 403 on every route without a scope.

fields.description: Field path → first message, on 422 validation_failed.

ApiErrorBody.description: Every error, whatever the status, has this shape.

source.description: Provenance. Every label must be explainable.

sourceAsset.description: Path payments: what the sender actually spent.

delegatedTo.description: EIP-7702: the contract this EOA delegates its code to.

dataStatus.description: partial/unavailable: some chain sources timed out; the score uses what arrived (labels always apply).

missing.description: Sources that didn't answer in time.

failureCount.description: Consecutive failed delivery attempts; the endpoint auto-disables at 20.
